today_challenge.title: Maximum Subarray with Bounded Diversity
today_challenge.description: Given an integer array `nums` and an integer `k`, return the maximum sum of any contiguous subarray containing at most `k` distinct elements.
today_challenge.problem_statement: Given an integer array `nums` and an integer `k`, return the maximum sum of any contiguous subarray containing at most `k` distinct elements.
today_challenge.input_format:
First line: JSON array `nums`.
Second line: integer `k`.
today_challenge.output_format: A single integer representing the maximum sum.
hints: Maintain a sliding window [left, right] with a frequency map.
Shrink from left when map size exceeds k.
